text:
anya: quick check before tomorrow's rollout: how do we account tokens when a pinned premium model falls back to an open model?
ron: options: bill requested, bill effective, or bill requested + track fallbacks for credits.
pat: leaning requested+track but enforce a per-tenant fallback allowance to prevent gaming.
anya: agreed. propose a leaky-bucket allowance: refill R, capacity B, consume tokens on each fallback.
ron: defaults? maybe R = max(1rps, 2% of committed tokens/min) and B = R*60. enterprise can override.
pat: enforcement modes: soft tag, visible downgrade banner, or probabilistic reject when bucket is empty. start with soft tag + dashboard.
infra-bot: alert: tenant=delta inc fallback_tokens=12k bucket_level=-1200 window=60s
anya: no auto-refunds. sustained deficit -> manual review for credits.
ron: infra action: add headers requested_model/effective_model+reason, emit per-tenant bucket metric with 1m buckets.
pat: i'll draft tiny RFC for allowance math and anti-gaming probes.
anya: ok ship plan: soft visibility tomorrow; hard gating next week after RFC. :thumbsup:
